hebrewText: אֶ֨ת כַּסְפְּ/ךָ֔ לֹֽא תִתֵּ֥ן ל֖/וֹ בְּ/נֶ֑שֶׁךְ וּ/בְ/מַרְבִּ֖ית לֹא תִתֵּ֥ן אָכְלֶֽ/ךָ

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)

not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
